blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: A robot policy needs to understand what a task is asking for in a scene, and how to move the robot to accomplish that task. To achieve these two skills, we introduce Zero-real Agent Policy (ZAP), a recipe that teaches a small off-the-shelf vision-language model to control a robot via a simple tool harness. We use a pretrained 27B parameter model to bootstrap world understanding and reasoning, followed by supervised fine-tuning and GRPO on simple simulated tasks to teach it how to move the robot. Without any real-world robot data during training, ZAP reaches 96.7% success on real-world tasks, matching GPT-6 Astra in our harness and outperforming the MolmoAct2 VLA (33.3%), while running 3x faster and 17x cheaper than GPT-6 Astra. We demonstrate that ZAP also generalizes to completely new objects, goals, strategies, and language by seating a test tube in a rack (and choosing a different hole in the rack when prompted), handing a test tube between arms mid-air, drawing an X on a tic-tac-toe board, and playing chess. These goals and types of manipulation don't appear in our training data. Furthermore, ZAP also transfers to an unseen embodiment. On a single-arm Franka, ZAP reaches 55.9% on RoboLab-120, 4.9 percentage points ahead of the leading VLA/WAM baseline.
blocks.zh: 一个机器人政策需要了解一个场景中的任务要求是什么,以及如何移动机器人来完成这个任务. 为了实现这两种技能,我们引入了"零现实"(Zero-real Agent Policy (ZAP)),这个配方教给一个小的现成的视觉语言模型,通过简单的工具吊带来控制机器人. 我们使用一个预先训练的27B参数模型来引导世界的理解和推理,然后在简单的模拟任务上进行有监督的微调和GPRO,教它如何移动机器人. ZAP在训练期间没有任何真实世界的机器人数据,在真实世界的任务上达到了96.7%的成功率,匹配了GPT-6 Astra在我们的操纵上,并且比"Molmo Act2 VLA"(33.3%)的成绩要好,同时运行速度快于GPT-6 Astra的3x和17x更便宜. 我们证明,ZAP也通过在架子上放入一个测试管(并在被催促时在架子上选择另一个孔口),在臂部中空之间发出测试管,在ttic-tac-toe板上画出一个X来概括到全新的物体,目标,策略和语言,并下棋. 我们的训练数据中没有这些目标和操控类型。 此外,ZAP还转移到一个看不见的化身。 在单臂Franka上,ZAP在RoboLab-120上达到55.9%,比VLA/WAM的领先基线提前了4.9个百分点.

blocks.en: Figure 1: Motion learned in simulation carries over to new real tasks that need reasoning. Left: two of the simulated training tasks. These simple pick and place, stacking, and reorientation tasks with everyday objects teach the model only how to move. Right: the same model, trained exclusively in simulation, tested zero-shot on a real bi-manual robot. No real robot data is used in training. Each task is new in a different way. The test tube and rack are a new object and a new goal. The mid-air handoff strategy has nothing close to it in the training distribution. Similarly, drawing an X in the center of a tic-tac-toe grid is a new type of manipulation guided by reading the board. Playing a mate in one requires reasoning about chess, drawing from the model’s pretraining capabilities.
blocks.zh: 图1:在模拟中学习到的动作接踵而来的是需要推理的新的真正任务. 左:两个模拟训练任务. 这些简单的选取和放置,堆放, 和方向调整任务与日常对象只教模型如何移动。 对:同一个模型,专门接受模拟训练,在真正的双人机器人上测试了零发. 没有真正的机器人数据用于训练. 每项任务都以不同的方式是新的。 试管和架子是一个新物体和一个新目标. 中空交接策略在训练分发中并无相近之处. 同样地,在ttic-tac-toe网格的中心绘制一个X是用读取板来指导的新型操纵. 玩伴棋需要从模型的预训能力中吸取对棋术的推理。

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en: A robot policy has to do two difficult things at once: it needs semantic reasoning to understand instructions in a potentially unfamiliar scene, and motion control to translate that understanding into precise physical actions.
blocks.zh: 一个机器人政策必须同时做两个困难的事情:它需要语义推理来理解一个可能不熟悉的场景中的指令,以及运动控制来将这种理解转化为精确的物理动作.

blocks.en:
We introduce Zero-real Agent Policy (ZAP), which adds motion to a small pretrained vision-language model through supervised fine-tuning (SFT) and reinforcement learning (RL), entirely in simulation.
We evaluate how these skills carry over to new tasks, real hardware, and a new embodiment.
Existing methods tend to trade off performance in one of these areas for the others, and broadly fall into three groups (Table 1 ).
blocks.zh:
我们引入了"零现实"代理政策(ZAP),它通过监督的微调和强化学习(RL),完全在模拟中将运动加到一个小型的先入为主的视觉语言模型上.
我们评估这些技能如何延续到新的任务、真正的硬件和新的化身。
现有方法往往将其中一个领域的绩效与另一个领域的绩效相交换,大致分为三类(表1)。

blocks.en: Models that directly output robot actions. Vision-language-action models (VLAs) and world-action models (WAMs) learn semantic reasoning & motion control from robot action data [ 1 , 2 , 3 , 4 ] . Because diverse action data is scarce, both skills end up tied to the training distribution: the policy often generalizes poorly to new prompts, objects, scenes and goals, and a new task usually means training again.
blocks.zh: 直接输出机器人动作的模型. 视觉-语言-动作模型(VLAs)和世界-动作模型(WAMS)从机器人动作数据中学习语义推理和运动控制[1,2,3,4]. 由于不同的动作数据很少,这两种技能最终都与培训分布挂钩:政策往往对新的提示,对象,场景和目标的概括不善,而新的任务通常意味着再次培训.

blocks.en:
Code that directly drives the robot. In Code as Policies [ 5 , 6 ] , a language model writes a program that composes perception and control APIs.
This is quick and reliable when the situations it will face can be anticipated when the program is written, but struggles outside that script, for example with an unexpected failure, an unfamiliar object or an ambiguous instruction. Adapting to a new task or scene means rewriting the program.
blocks.zh:
直接驱动机器人的密码 在"代码"中作为"政策"[5,6],一个语言模型会写出一个编译感知和控制API的程序.
这在程序被写入时可以预料到它将面临的情况时是迅速而可靠的,但会在该脚本之外挣扎,例如遇到出乎意料的失败,不熟悉的对象或模棱两可的指令. 适应新的任务或场景意味着重写程序.

blocks.en: Large frontier models controlling the robot through tools. Frontier language models interacting with the robot via an agentic harness bring world understanding, reasoning and generalization [ 7 , 8 , 9 ] . But they are not explicitly trained to move a robot, and a trillion-parameter model is slow and costs dollars for a task that smaller policy models, when they can do them, do in seconds and cost pennies.
blocks.zh: 大型前沿模型通过工具控制机器人. 边疆语言模型通过一种特异性拉带与机器人相互作用,带来了世界理解,推理和通俗化[7,8,9]. 但他们并没有被明确训练来移动机器人,一个万亿参数模型是缓慢的,并且花费了美元来完成一个较小的政策模型,当它们能够完成的时候,在几秒钟内完成,花费了便士.

blocks.en: Table 1: Comparing robot policy paradigms. VLAs/WAMs and Code as Policies offer fast, inexpensive execution, while frontier agents provide broader generalization at higher latency and cost. ZAP combines fast, low-cost execution with generalization to new instructions, objects, scenes, and goals.
blocks.zh: 表1:机器人政策范式比较。 作为政策,VLA/WAMS和《守则》提供快速、廉价的执行,而边境代理人则以更高的时间和成本提供更广泛的普及。 ZAP将快而低成本的执行与通俗化结合到新的指令,对象,场景,和目标上.

blocks.en: ZAP combines semantic reasoning from vision-language pretraining with motion control learned entirely in simulation. We start with Qwen 3.6 27B [ 10 ] , which contributes world understanding and reasoning. We then teach the model motion control in simulation - first SFT on its own mined successful traces, followed by RL across 40 pick-and-place, stacking, and reorientation tasks. Neither stage uses real-world robot demonstrations. At test time, the policy combines pretrained semantic reasoning with learned motion control to perform real-world tasks it was never trained to execute, generalizing to new objects, goals, and robot embodiments.
blocks.zh: ZAP将视觉语言预训的语义推理和完全从模拟中学习的运动控制结合起来. 我们从Quen 3.6 27B [10] 开始,它有助于世界的理解和推理. 然后我们在模拟中教模型运动控制 - 首先是SFT在它自己开采的成功痕迹上,然后是RL在40个取地,堆放,和重定向任务上. 两个舞台都使用现实世界的机器人演示. 在测试时,政策将预先训练的语义推理与学习的动作控制结合起来,以执行现实世界的任务,它从未被训练过执行,被概括到新的物体,目标,和机器人的化身.

blocks.en: Our contributions are as follows: • Teacher-free training of an agent policy in simulation. We teach a pretrained vision-language model to control a robot with no frontier teacher and no real robot data. The model commands end-effector poses and gripper openings through a harness that is identical in simulation and on hardware. We seed it with successful traces mined from its own rollouts, then refine it with RL using a dense reward ladder that credits partial progress (§ 3 ). • Transfer to hardware and new embodiment. With no real-world robot training data, ZAP matches GPT-6 Astra on 10 real tasks at 3 × \times the speed and 1/17 the cost. The same checkpoint transfers without retraining to a completely new embodiment (single-arm Franka) exceeding the performance of leading VLA/WAM baselines on RoboLab-120 (§ 4 ). • Generalization to new goals, language, and reasoning. ZAP combines pretrained semantic reasoning with learned motion control to execute real-world tasks unseen during robot training. The policy handles new objects and goals, follows instructions for manipulation strategies it never practiced, and applies complex reasoning to tasks such as chess and drawing (§ 5 ).
blocks.zh: 我们的贡献如下: 无师资模拟政策培训。 我们教一个预先训练的视觉语言模型来控制一个没有前沿老师,没有真实机器人数据的机器人. 模型通过一个在模拟和硬件上完全相同的绳索来命令终端效应器和抓取器。 我们用它自己推出的成功痕迹进行播种,然后使用密集的奖励梯子加以精炼,从而获得部分进展(第3节)。 由于没有真实世界的机器人训练数据,ZAP与GPT-6 Astra在10个真实任务上相匹配,速度为3×\时,成本为1/17. 同样的检查站在没有再培训的情况下向全新的模具(单臂Franka)转移,超过了在RoboLab-120(第4节)上主要VLA/WAM基线的表现。 • 普及到新的目标、语言和推理。 ZAP将预先训练的语义推理与所学的运动控制结合起来,执行机器人训练期间所未见的现实世界任务. 该政策处理新的对象和目标,遵循它从未执行的操纵策略的指示,并对象棋和绘图等任务采用复杂的推理(§5).

blocks.en: Teacher-free training of an agent policy in simulation. We teach a pretrained vision-language model to control a robot with no frontier teacher and no real robot data. The model commands end-effector poses and gripper openings through a harness that is identical in simulation and on hardware. We seed it with successful traces mined from its own rollouts, then refine it with RL using a dense reward ladder that credits partial progress (§ 3 ).
blocks.zh: 无师生模拟政策培训. 我们教一个预先训练的视觉语言模型来控制一个没有前沿老师,没有真实机器人数据的机器人. 模型通过一个在模拟和硬件上完全相同的绳索来命令终端效应器和抓取器。 我们用它自己推出的成功痕迹来播种,然后用高密度的奖励梯子加以改进,以获得部分进展(第3节)。

blocks.en: Transfer to hardware and new embodiment. With no real-world robot training data, ZAP matches GPT-6 Astra on 10 real tasks at 3 × \times the speed and 1/17 the cost. The same checkpoint transfers without retraining to a completely new embodiment (single-arm Franka) exceeding the performance of leading VLA/WAM baselines on RoboLab-120 (§ 4 ).
blocks.zh: 转入硬件和新化身. 由于没有真实世界的机器人训练数据,ZAP与GPT-6 Astra在10个真实任务上相匹配,速度为3×\时,成本为1/17. 同样的检查站在没有再培训的情况下向全新的模具(单臂Franka)转移,超过了在RoboLab-120(第4节)上主要VLA/WAM基线的表现。

blocks.en: Generalization to new goals, language, and reasoning. ZAP combines pretrained semantic reasoning with learned motion control to execute real-world tasks unseen during robot training. The policy handles new objects and goals, follows instructions for manipulation strategies it never practiced, and applies complex reasoning to tasks such as chess and drawing (§ 5 ).
blocks.zh: 概括到新的目标、语言和推理。 ZAP将预先训练的语义推理与所学的运动控制结合起来,执行机器人训练期间所未见的现实世界任务. 该政策处理新的对象和目标,遵循它从未执行的操纵策略的指示,并对象棋和绘图等任务采用复杂的推理(§5).

blocks.en: 2 Related work
blocks.zh: 2 相关工作

blocks.en: Composing reasoning and motion. Task-and-motion planners compose symbolic operators that ground into geometric motion [ 11 , 12 ] . Large language models then proved to be better high-level planners, sequencing a library of learned skills [ 13 , 14 , 15 ] or handing subgoals to low-level policies [ 16 , 17 ] . ZAP keeps the split between reasoning and motion but drops the fixed skill library. Motion is a skill the model learns itself, through a minimal harness that leaves scene reasoning and action sequencing to the model rather than imposing macros that simplify familiar tasks but limit generalization.
blocks.zh: 提出推理和动议。 任务和运动规划者由象征性的操作者组成,这些操作者将形成几何运动[11,12]. 然后,大型语文模式被证明是更好的高级别规划者,对学习技能的图书馆进行排序[13、14、15]或将次级目标交给低级政策[16、17]。 ZAP保持推理和运动的分出,但放弃了固定技能库. 运动是模型自我学习的一种技能,通过一种最小的把场景推理和行动顺序留给模型,而不是强制进行简化熟悉的任务而限制概括的宏.

blocks.en: End-to-end policies. VLAs and WAMs fold reasoning and motion into one network trained on robot actions [ 1 , 3 , 18 , 4 ] . Several studies show that these policies keep the intent of an instruction but fail to execute it on new tasks, perturbations or skill combinations [ 19 , 20 , 21 , 22 ] . ZAP instead inherits the reasoning and language ability of a pretrained LLM and learns only motion, in simulation. It never has to learn language from action data, so it is not tied to the instructions that data happens to contain, and it follows what an instruction means rather than how it is worded.
blocks.zh: 端对端政策. VLAs和WAMs将推理和运动折叠为一个网络,接受机器人动作训练[1,3,18,4]. 几项研究表明,这些政策保留着一项指示的意图,但未能在新的任务、扰动或技能组合上加以执行[19、20、21、22]。 ZAP转而继承了预训LLM的推理和语言能力,只学习运动,在模拟中. 它从来不需要从动作数据中学习语言,因此它与数据恰好包含的指令没有绑定关系,它遵循的是指令的含义,而不是其措辞方式.

blocks.en: Foundation models as robot agents. Code as Policies and its successors compose perception and control APIs into programs [ 5 , 23 ] , and frontier agents now act directly as closed-loop policies through tool harnesses [ 7 , 8 , 9 ] . They bring reasoning for free, but they are slow, expensive and not trained to move a robot. The closest work trains compact tool-calling agents, mostly by distilling a frontier teacher: Guava into a 4B agent with object-referenced grasp and align tools, refined with GRPO on two tasks [ 24 ] , RACaP into an 8B model over evolved policy APIs [ 25 ] , and Robo-Harness K1 into a 9B student evaluated in simulation [ 9 ] . ZAP uses no teacher: its fine-tuning data are its own successful rollouts, and RL trains it on all 40 tasks, so no teacher sets its ceiling. It commands complete end-effector poses rather than grasp macros. Guava’s unseen tasks recombine the grasp, place and push primitives it was trained on; ZAP composes motions it never practiced, such as a mid-air handoff and a marker stroke, and runs on a different robot without retraining.
blocks.zh: 基础模型作为机器人代理. 守则作为政策及其后续者将认知和控制API组成方案[5、23],边境代理人现在通过工具手段直接充当封闭式政策[7、8、9]。 他们带来了免费的推理,但他们缓慢,昂贵,没有受过移动机器人的训练. 最接近的工作是训练紧凑的工具调用剂,主要是通过提炼前沿教师: Guava成为了4B的代理,具有对象引用的抓取和对接工具,在两个任务上与GRPO进行了精炼[24],RACaP成为了8B模型而超越了已演化的政策API[25],Robo-Harness K1成为了在模拟中评价的9B学生[9]. ZAP不用老师:它的微调数据是自己的成功推出,RL就全部40个任务对其进行了培训,所以没有老师设定了上限. 它命令完全的终端效应器 而不是抓住宏。 瓜娃的隐形任务重塑了它所训练的掌握、放置和推倒原始人;ZAP编织了它从未练习过的动作,如中空接力和中风等,并在没有再训练的情况下运行在另一个机器人上。

blocks.en: 3 Method
blocks.zh: 3 方法

blocks.en: Figure 2: Three scenes, one shared interface. Left to right: separate banana-in-bowl episodes on the simulated bi-manual YAM, the real YAM, and a simulated single-arm Franka, an embodiment never seen in training. From the agent’s perspective, the only thing that changes is the system prompt specifying the details of the robot and camera layouts. Across all three settings, ZAP uses the same interface: camera images annotated with SAM 3.1 masks and numbered boxes, 3D object readouts, end-effector pose commands, and controller feedback. The box below shows one step from the Franka episode: a 3D object readout, the agent’s move_to command, and the motion controller’s response. Both YAM settings use these same formats.
blocks.zh: 图2: 三幕一分享界面. 左出右出:在模拟双手版YAM上分别出香蕉入瓶出场,真作YAM出场;而模拟出单臂法兰卡出场,是训练中从未见过的出演. 从代理的角度来看,唯一改变的是系统会迅速指定机器人和相机布局的细节. 在所有三种设置中,ZAP都使用相同的接口:带有SAM 3.1口罩和编号框的相机图像,3D对象读取,端效器会出站命令,以及控制器反馈. 下面的框显示出从"弗兰克"一集的一步:一个3D对象读出,代理的移动_到命令,以及运动控制器的反应. YAM两种设置都使用同一种格式.

blocks.en: We first describe the harness, the tool interface through which the model perceives and acts, identical in simulation and on hardware (§ 3.1 ). We then describe how we train the model to move entirely in simulation using GRPO and a dense reward ladder (§ 3.2 ), and how we initialize that run from successful traces gathered by a short GRPO warm-up and prefix-tree search (§ 3.3 ).
blocks.zh: 我们首先描述了模型在模拟和硬件上所感同身受的工具界面。 然后,我们描述我们如何利用GRPO和密集的奖励阶梯来训练模型在模拟中完全移动(第3.2节),以及我们如何初始化从GRPO热身和前缀树搜索中采集的成功痕迹(第3.3节).

blocks.en: 3.1 One interface across simulation and hardware
blocks.zh: 3.1 国家 一个跨越模拟和硬件的接口

blocks.en: ZAP controls two 6-DoF (degrees-of-freedom) YAM arms with parallel-jaw grippers [ 26 ] . It commands absolute end-effector poses and gripper openings, rather than joint angles, trajectories, or action chunks. We frame tasks as a conversation between the model and its environment through the harness: the model first writes a plan and names the objects to locate based on camera views of the environment, then repeatedly issues perception and movement tool calls to complete its task.
blocks.zh: ZAP控制了两只6-DoF(自由度)YAM手臂并配有并发-jaw抓手 [26]. 它命令绝对的末端效应器摆出和抓取开口,而不是联合角度,轨迹,或动作块. 我们把任务设定为模型和它的环境之间通过被拉带的对话:模型首先会写出一个计划并取出根据相机对环境的观察来定位对象的名字,然后反复发出感知和运动工具的呼唤来完成它的任务.

blocks.en: The harness uses SAM 3.1 [ 27 , 28 ] to segment the objects named in the model’s perception queries in each camera stream. These masks are combined with calibrated depth cameras to yield each object’s 3D centroid, height, and principal axes. This process runs continuously and asynchronously in the background: the model steers perception by changing its queries, and receives object measurements and annotated camera images.
blocks.zh: 该接头使用SAM 3.1 [27,28]将模型感知查询中命名的物体分出在每个相机流中. 这些口罩与校准的深度相机结合,可以产生出每个物体的3D半径,高度和主轴. 这个过程在背景中持续并同步地运行:模型通过改变它的查询来引导感知,并接收对象测量和注释相机图像.

blocks.en: The model controls the robot and manages the episode through five tools, two of which move the robot: move_to sets a complete end-effector pose for one or both arms, and set_gripper sets each jaw opening. change_query sets what perception looks for, update_todo keeps a short plan in view across turns, and done ends the episode. There are no grasp macros or motion primitives, so every approach, grasp, lift and release is a sequence of these two motion tools that the model plans itself.
blocks.zh: 模型通过5个工具控制了机器人并管理了剧集,其中2个工具移动了机器人:为一臂或两臂设置了完整的最终效果器,并设置了-gripper设定了每个下颚开口. change_query)设定了感想所寻找的东西,更新_todo保持了跨转弯的短视计划,并完成了结束剧集. 没有抓取的宏或运动原始,所以每一个取取取取取取取取取出,都是模型自己规划的这两个运动工具的序列.

blocks.en: Appendix A describes the rest of the harness: the pose and orientation parameterization, the observations, validation, the motion controller and its outcome reports, and how the same harness runs in simulation and on hardware. Appendix B steps through a complete real-robot episode turn by turn.
blocks.zh: 附 录 A描述了其余的被套:姿势和方向参数化,观测,验证,运动控制器及其结果报告,以及同样的被套在模拟和硬件上是如何运行的. 附 录 B通过一个完整的真正的机器人剧集 逐个转弯。

blocks.en: 3.2 Learning to move in simulation
blocks.zh: 3.2 在模拟中学习移动

blocks.en: We build our simulated tasks in Isaac Sim [ 29 ] by adding simulated YAM arms with calibrated cameras and arm dynamics against real YAM arms.
blocks.zh: 我们在Isaac Sim[29]建造模拟任务,增加模拟YAM武器,并配有校准相机和手臂动力学来对抗真正的YAM武器.

blocks.en: Learning motion control on simulated tasks. We design 40 simulated tasks, none of which appear in RoboLab-120, that exercise the same families of everyday object manipulation skills: grasping and lifting, single- and multi-object pick and place, stacking, and reorientation. The goals are deliberately simple, and none requires heavy reasoning. This lets us test whether motion control learned on simple tasks can combine with pretrained semantic reasoning to solve unseen tasks with new goals and strategies.
blocks.zh: 模拟任务的学习运动控制. 我们设计了40个模拟任务,其中没有一个出现在RoboLab-120中,这些任务在日常的物体操纵技能方面具有相同的家族:抓取和起取,单物和多物取取地取地取地取地取地取地取地取地取地取地取地取地取地取地取地取地取地取地取地取地取地取地取地取地取地取地取地取地取地取地取地取地取地取地取地取地取地取地取地取地取地取地取地取地取地取地取地取地取地取地取地取地取地取地取地取地取地取地取地取地取地取地取地取地取地取地取地取地取地取地取地取地取地取地取地取地取地取地取地取地取地取地取地取地取地取地取地取地取地取地取地取地取地取地取地取地取地取地取地取地取地取地取地取地取地取 目标刻意简单,不需要沉重的推理。 这让我们来检验在简单任务上学到的动作控制是否能够结合经过预先训练的语义推理,用新的目标和战略来解决看不见的任务.

blocks.en: GRPO with dense rewards. The GRPO run is initialized from the checkpoint detailed in § 3.3 and trains on all 40 tasks (hyperparameters in Appendix C ). Binary reward based on task success is inefficient since some tasks start with zero successes, and therefore a pass/fail reward would provide zero advantage and contribute no gradient. We instead shape a dense ladder of partial credit judged on the final state of the scene, manually designed per task type.
blocks.zh: GRPO有密集的奖励。 GRPO运行从第3.3节所详述的检查站和所有40个任务的列车(附录C中的全程仪表)中初始化. 基于任务成功的二进制奖励效率低下,因为有些任务从零成功开始,因此通过/失败奖励将带来零优势,不产生梯度. 相反,我们塑造了一个密集的梯子 部分信用 判断在现场的最终状态, 手工设计每个任务类型。

blocks.en: For example, for pick and place tasks, approaching the object earns up to 0.2 in proportion to the gripper fingertip-to-object distance closed; grasping earns 0.2 and lifting up to a further 0.55, in proportion to height up to 8 cm. Transport raises the total to at most 0.9, in proportion to the distance to the goal closed. Completing a task earns 5.0, minus a small length penalty which penalizes the model for taking too many turns to complete the task. The specific numbers for partial credit were not ablated and instead holistically chosen: our guiding principle was that final task success must have a much higher reward than partial reward; otherwise, the model settles for collecting partial credit. The success checker is hardened against reward hacking, for example, by requiring that the goal hold for at least half a second.
blocks.zh: 例如,在取取和放置任务时,接近物体的所得与取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取 运输按距离目标关闭的距离比例,将总数提高到最多0.9。 完成一项任务可赚到5.0分,再减去一个小的长度处罚,该处罚因该模式轮到太多人来完成任务而受到惩罚。 部分信贷的具体数字没有减少,而是从整体上加以选择:我们的指导原则是,最后任务的成功必须比部分信贷的回报高得多;否则,模式就解决了收取部分信贷的问题。 成功检查器对奖励黑客的打击更加强硬,例如要求目标至少保持半秒.

blocks.en: We penalize turns where either no tool call is made, or where invalid motion is proposed and doesn’t pass certain validation checks (see Appendix A ). These turns (but not the whole sequence) receive a negative advantage, regardless of the episode’s score. In earlier runs without these penalties, the corresponding error rates reached as high as 4% and 34%, respectively. With penalties, these rates fall to 0% and 3%.
blocks.zh: 或提出无效动议且不通过某些验证检查(见附录A), 这些转会(但不是整集)获得负面优势,无论该集的分数如何. 在以前没有这些处罚的情况下,相应的出错率分别高达4%和34%. 如果惩罚,这些比率会降至0%和3%。

blocks.en: 3.3 Initializing the model
blocks.zh: 3.3 模型的初始化

blocks.en: Seeding the model with its own successes. A model which is on-distribution for its task space helps reduce variance during RL training, so we first fine-tune on successful agent traces. That raises the question of how to collect them. One option is rejection sampling from either our fixed base model or a larger open model. However, this is prohibitively inefficient, and many tasks never succeed even after hundreds of attempts per task. Instead, initializing from the base model, we run a short GRPO warm-up run of several dozen steps and over-sample the harder tasks, and mine its successful rollouts for SFT. As the policy improves, harder tasks start to yield successes, so the data comes from a slightly evolved version of the model itself, a self-distillation loop that is close to on-policy.
blocks.zh: 以自己的成功为模式播种. 一个用于分配任务空间的模型有助于减少RL训练期间的差异,因此我们首先对成功的代理痕迹进行微调. 这就产生了如何收集这些地雷的问题。 一个选择是拒绝从我们的固定基数模型或更大的开放模型中取样。 然而,这种效率低得令人望而却步,许多任务即使在每项任务进行上百次努力之后也从未取得成功。 相反,我们从基础模型中初始化, 运行了一个短短的GRPO热身运行 几十个步骤, 和过度样本 更难的任务, 随着政策的改进,更艰巨的任务开始产生成功,因此数据来自模型本身的略为演变的版本,即接近于政策上的自消循环.

blocks.en: Prefix-tree search. For tasks that still never succeed, we perform a tree-search over partial episodes (Appendix Figure 8 ). A node is created after each physical action settles; to expand it, we reset the simulator to the task’s deterministic start, replay the node’s stored actions, restore the agent’s context, and sample a new continuation. A best-first rule favors high dense reward and less-explored nodes and prunes failing branches, with up to about 1,000 leaves per task. This found successful traces for several tasks that RL sampling never solved, and these traces are added to the fine-tuning data.
blocks.zh: 前缀-树木搜索. 对于仍然从未成功的任务,我们对部分事件进行树搜索(附录图8 ). 在每次物理动作解决后都会创建一个节点;为了扩大节点,我们将模拟器重置为任务的决定性开始,重放节点存储的动作,恢复代理的上下文,并取出新的续作样本. 一个最优先的规则倾向于高密度的奖励和较少探索的节点和倒分枝,每个任务最多可有1000个叶子. 这为RL采样从未解决的几个任务找到了成功的痕迹,这些痕迹被添加到微调数据中.

blocks.en: 4 Quantitative evaluation
blocks.zh: 4 定量评价

blocks.en: We perform quantitative evaluation on tasks in bimanual simulation, on real hardware, and on a new embodiment. We finally examine two ablations on data quality and embodiment.
blocks.zh: 我们对双人模拟、真正的硬件和新的化身等任务进行定量评估。 最后,我们审查了关于数据质量和体现的两个问题。

blocks.en: 4.1 Simulation on the Bimanual YAM
blocks.zh: 4.1 模拟双人YAM

blocks.en: Table 2: Success on the bimanual YAM adaptation of RoboLab-120 [ 30 ] . ZAP exceeds both GPT-6 Astra and Opus 5.5.
blocks.zh: 表2:RoboLab-120双人YAM改编成功 [30]. ZAP超过了GPT-6 Astra和Opus 5.5.

blocks.en: SFT raises success on RoboLab-120 from the base model’s 8.3% to 58.3%, and RL raises it to 74.0% (Table 2 ), above both GPT-6 Astra and Opus 5.5. Motion learned on 40 simple tasks carries over to new objects and tasks.
blocks.zh: SFT将RoboLab-120的成功率从基准模型的8.3%提高到58.3%,RL将其提高到74.0%(表2),高于GPT-6 Astra和Opus 5.5。 在40个简单任务上学习到的动作会延续到新的对象和任务.

blocks.en: Note that, with the same harness, the base Qwen model fails on almost every task. Looking at its thinking, it clearly understands the scene and goal. What it lacks is the ability to properly move the robot. It fails to choose the right grasp orientation and height, approach the object correctly and translate 3D perception into motion commands. Training with SFT and RL adds this missing motion control skill.
blocks.zh: 需要注意的是,用同样的绳索,基础Quen模型几乎在每个任务上都失败了. 从它的思维来看,它清楚地理解了场景和目标. 它缺乏的是能够正确移动机器人的能力. 它未能选择正确的取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取 SFT和RL的训练增加了这种缺失的运动控制技能.

blocks.en: 4.2 Real-world transfer
blocks.zh: 4.2 实际世界转让

blocks.en: Setup. We recreate 10 tasks of diverse complexity from the RoboLab-120 task list on the real robot (Appendix D lists each task prompt and each model’s success rate). We ran 3 trials per task on a bimanual rig with two YAM arms and the same three-camera layout as in simulation. We compare against GPT-6 Astra [ 31 ] (reasoning level max) in our harness, GPT-6 Astra in the Robocurve Inspect Robots harness [ 8 , 32 ] , MolmoAct2 [ 4 ] , a public VLA for bimanual YAM arms, and the base Qwen 3.6 27B we started from.
blocks.zh: 设相. 我们从真正机器人上的RoboLab-120任务列表(附录D列出每个任务提示和每个模型的成功率)中重现出10个复杂多样的任务. 我们用两只YAM臂和三相机布局的双相机进行三次试验。 我们比较了GPT-6 Astra [31] (合理级别最大) 和GPT-6 Astra 在Robocurve Inspector Robots 的用具[8,32],MolmoAct2 [4], 一个用于双人YAM武器的公共VLA, 以及我们从头开始的Qwen 3.6 27B.

blocks.en: Table 3: Real-world results. Left: success rate (%) over 30 trials per model. Right: mean ± \pm std per task. ZAP is served with vLLM [ 33 ] on one B300 priced at $7.10/hour, with a 2-token multi-token-prediction head.
blocks.zh: 表3:现实世界的成果。 左:成功率(%),每个模型30次以上。 对:每个任务平均为±\pm std. ZAP在1个以7.10/小时价格定价的B300上服务于vLLM [33],并有2个多键-预测头.

blocks.en: Parity with GPT-6 Astra. ZAP matches GPT-6 Astra in the same harness (Table 3 ), and both clearly outperform GPT-6 Astra in the Robocurve harness, MolmoAct2, and the base model. The base model, with the same reasoning and harness but no motion training, succeeds on 16.7%.
blocks.zh: 与GPT-6 Astra对等. ZAP与同一种系带中的GPT-6 Astra相匹配(表3),两者在Robocurve系带,MolmoAct2和基底模型中都明显优于GPT-6 Astra. 基础模型具有相同的推理和运用,但没有运动训练,在16.7%上成功.

blocks.en: Where the VLA breaks. MolmoAct2’s failures follow the meaning of the instruction more than the difficulty of the motion (Appendix Table 6 ). For example, we evaluate the model’s ability to pick & place a Rubik’s cube in different locations. When asked to place in a bowl, it places it successfully 3/3 times. But when prompted to place the cube behind the bowl, it never succeeds (0/3), often still placing it into the bowl. In another task, the VLA must place exactly 3 bananas in a bin and always places too many. The motions are nearly the same; what changes is a spatial relation or count, reflected in the prompt. A VLA can only learn what words like behind or exactly three mean from its robot action data, whereas ZAP already understands them from vision-language pretraining.
blocks.zh: 甚么处来. 摩尔莫 Act2的失败比运动的难度更遵循指示的意义(附录表6.). 例如,我们评价模型在不同的地点取出并放置Rubik立方体的能力。 当被要求放入一碗时,它成功放入了3/3次. 但是,当被促使将立方体放入碗后时,它从未成功(0/3),经常仍然被放入碗中. 在另一项任务中,VLA必须把3个香蕉完全放入一个垃圾桶,并且总是放置过多. 运动几乎相同;变化是空间关系或计数,反映于即时. 一个VLA只能从它的机器人动作数据中学习到后面的"等词"或确切的"三个"的意思,而ZAP已经从视觉语言预训中了解了.

blocks.en: Harness comparison. The same GPT-6 Astra succeeds in 96.7% of trials in our harness and in 36.7% in the Robocurve harness. A capable model is not enough on its own: what it observes and how it can act shape what it achieves.
blocks.zh: 机能对比. 同样的GPT-6 Astra在96.7%的试验中成功,在Robocurve试验中成功36.7%. 一个有能力的模型单靠自己是不够的:它所观察到的,以及它如何能够塑造它的成就。

blocks.en: 3 × \times faster, 17 × \times cheaper. ZAP completes a task in 146 s on average against 397 s for GPT-6 Astra. Both models take a similar number of turns, so all of the gain comes from faster model responses: 6.2 s per turn against 19 s. Per task, ZAP costs an estimated $0.29 against $4.87.
blocks.zh: 3×时速更快,17×时价格更便宜. ZAP平均完成146 s的任务,而GPT-6 Astra平均完成397 s. 两种模型都采用相近的回合数,因此所有收益都来自更快的模型响应:每回合6.2 s对19 s. 每项任务,ZAP费用估计为0.29美元,而4.87美元。

blocks.en: 4.3 Transfer to a new embodiment
blocks.zh: 4.3 转到新的化身

blocks.en: Generalization to a new robot embodiment comes for free. We take the same checkpoint, trained only on bimanual YAM arms, and evaluate it on a single-arm Franka. From the agent’s perspective, only the system prompt describing the embodiment changes; the harness stays exactly the same. The Franka differs from the YAM in most of the ways that matter to a policy that outputs joint angles or action chunks: one arm instead of two, seven joints instead of six, a different gripper, different reach, and different cameras. ZAP is unaffected by these differences: it commands end-effector poses through the harness, which handles the embodiment-specific joint control.
blocks.zh: 向新的机器人化身的通俗化是免费的。 我们使用同一个检查站,只训练双臂YAM武器,用单臂Franka来评估. 从代理人的角度看,只有系统能促使人们描述浮出水面的变化;绳子保持不变。 Franka与YAM在大多数重要方式上都不同,而是一种输出关节角或动作块的政策:一个手臂而不是两个,七个关节而不是六个,一个不同的抓取器,不同的伸展,不同的相机. ZAP不受这些差异所影响:它通过控制带指挥端-效应器所摆出,控制着特有浮雕的联合控制.

blocks.en: Table 4: The same motion skill on a new robot. Without any Franka training, ZAP exceeds Lakeside and FLUX 3 Action, the leading VLA/WAM policies on the current RoboLab-120 leaderboard [ 34 ] .
blocks.zh: 表4:新机器人上相同的运动技能. ZAP在没有任何弗兰卡训练的情况下超越了Lakeside和FLUX 3 Action,这是当前RoboLab-120领跑板上主要的VLA/WAM政策. [34].

blocks.en: On RoboLab-120 it reaches 55.9%, ahead of Lakeside (51%) and FLUX 3 Action (42.9%), the current state-of-the-art VLA/WAM baselines (Table 4 ). What the model learned in simulation is therefore not a mapping tied to the YAM arms, but how to manipulate the robot arm through space to move an object to a target. The harness lets that skill carry over from two arms to one without retraining.
blocks.zh: 在RoboLab-120号机上,它达到55.9%,领先于Lakeside(51%)和FLUX 3 Action(42.9%),这是目前最先进的VLA/WAM基线(表4)。 因此模型在模拟中学到的并不是与YAM臂相接的映射,而是如何从太空中操纵机器人臂来将物体移动到目标上. 这种技巧从两只手臂传到一臂,而不经过再培训。

blocks.en: 4.4 Ablations
blocks.zh: 4.4 拖欠款项

blocks.en: Better SFT data improves generalization. We compare two SFT runs: one using 455 successful traces mined early in GRPO, and one using 3.9k traces mined more aggressively after GRPO runs longer, especially on harder tasks. RoboLab-120 success rises from 17.2% to 58.3% (Table 5 , left), a gain of 41.1 points from the same recipe with better data. The longer run mines especially the harder tasks that the early policy rarely solved, so the model sees how to succeed on a wider range of tasks, and that breadth carries over to tasks it never trained on.
blocks.zh: 更好的SFT数据可以改善通俗化. 我们比较了两次SFT运行:一次使用在GRPO早期所开采的455个成功痕迹,另一次使用在GRPO运行更长时间后更活跃地所开采的3.9克痕迹,特别是在更艰巨的任务上. RoboLab-120的成功率从17.2%上升至58.3%(表5,左),从同一配方得到41.1分的数据较好。 地雷的寿命越长,特别是早期政策很少解决的更艰巨的任务,因此,该模式看到如何在范围更广的任务上取得成功,而这种宽度将延续到它从未受过训练的任务上。

blocks.en: The recipe also works when trained directly on Franka. Separately, we train Qwen-3.5 9B on single-arm Isaac Sim tasks. As before, none of these tasks appear in the RoboLab-120 evaluation. We use a smaller 9B model both for faster experiments, and to test whether the recipe also holds at a smaller scale. We follow a similar, lighter version of the recipe as above; we first train on 4.6k examples gathered from mining successes from GRPO runs, before performing a final GRPO run. The policy exceeds current SOTA VLAs (Table 5 , right), suggesting that the recipe works across model sizes and embodiments while preserving generalization to entirely unseen tasks.
blocks.zh: 食谱在直接接受法兰卡训练时也有作用. 另外,我们用单臂Isaac Sim的任务训练了Quen-3.5 9B. 与以往一样,这些任务都没有出现在RoboLab-120评价中. 我们使用一个更小的9B模型来进行更快的实验, 并测试食谱是否也维持在更小的规模。 我们遵循上述类似、较轻的配方;我们首先从GRPO的采矿成功中收集了4.6克实例,然后进行最后的GRPO运行。 该政策超越了目前的SOTA VLA(表5,对),表明食谱在模型大小和表现上都起作用,同时将通俗化保留在完全看不见的任务上.

blocks.en: Table 5: Ablations. Left: more extensive trace mining improves SFT generalization on RoboLab-120 with the bimanual YAM. Right: a 9B model trained directly on separate single-arm Isaac Sim tasks also transfers to RoboLab-120. Lakeside and FLUX 3 Action results are from the benchmark leaderboard [ 34 ] .
blocks.zh: 表5:虚损. 左:更广泛的痕量开采改进了用双人YAM在RoboLab-120上对SFT的概括. 右:一个直接接受单臂Isaac Sim任务训练的9B型号,也转会至RoboLab-120. Lakeside和FLUX 3 动作结果出自基准领导板 [34].

blocks.en: 5 Composing the skills on new tasks
blocks.zh: 页:1 掌握新任务的技能

blocks.en: We next test the model, trained exclusively in simulation, on real-world tasks far outside anything seen in training, from bimanual handoffs to drawing and chess, each requiring reasoning and motion the model never practiced (Figure 1 ).
blocks.zh: 接下来我们测试这个模型, 专门接受模拟训练, 测试现实世界的任务, 远远超出训练中所看到的任何任务, 从双人交接到绘画和下棋, 每一个都需要推理和运动模型从未练习过(图1)。

blocks.en: What generalization we are looking for. • New tasks and objects: the policy should handle objects, scenes, and goals that appear nowhere in training, and construct a physical strategy for them without demonstrations. • New strategies on request: it should be possible to prompt the policy into manipulations it never practiced, such as coordinating two arms. • Complex reasoning: the policy should be able to carry over the reasoning capabilities the pretrained LLM has into physical world actions. • Language and instruction following: VLAs are notoriously sensitive to their prompts—slight deviations that do not change the meaning can significantly change the policy success rate [ 35 ] .
blocks.zh: • 我们所寻求的概况。 新的任务和目标:政策应处理在训练中无处出现的物体、场景和目标,并为它们制定实际战略,而不进行演示。 二. 支助 应请求制定新的战略:应当能够促使该政策被操纵,例如协调两只武器。 • 复杂推理:政策应能够将经过预先训练的LLM的推理能力带入物理世界行动。 • 下列语文和教学: VLA对其提示有臭名昭著的敏感性——轻而易举的偏差不会改变意义,可以显著地改变政策成功率[35].

blocks.en: New tasks and objects: the policy should handle objects, scenes, and goals that appear nowhere in training, and construct a physical strategy for them without demonstrations.
blocks.zh: 新的任务和目标:政策应处理在训练中无处出现的物体、场景和目标,并为它们制定实际战略,而不进行演示。

blocks.en: New strategies on request: it should be possible to prompt the policy into manipulations it never practiced, such as coordinating two arms.
blocks.zh: 应请求制定新的战略:应当能够促使该政策被操纵,例如协调两只武器。

blocks.en: Complex reasoning: the policy should be able to carry over the reasoning capabilities the pretrained LLM has into physical world actions.
blocks.zh: 复杂的推理:政策应能够将预先训练的LLM的推理能力带入物理世界行动.

blocks.en: Language and instruction following: VLAs are notoriously sensitive to their prompts—slight deviations that do not change the meaning can significantly change the policy success rate [ 35 ] .
blocks.zh: 下列语言和教学: VLA对其提示有臭名昭著的敏感性——轻而易举的偏差不会改变意义,可以显著地改变政策成功率[35].

blocks.en: A new object and a new task: the test tube. We ask the model to vertically lower a test tube into a rack (Figure 3 ). Both objects and the goal are unseen in training. The model constructs the strategy itself: it grasps the tube lying on its side, turns the gripper so the tube is vertical, and lowers it into a hole. This is challenging because, at the moment of placement, the hole is hidden from every camera. A VLA would typically need task-specific demonstrations of each of these steps; ZAP receives only a single text instruction and, without demonstrations or parameter updates, infers the required motion.
blocks.zh: 新对象与新任务:试管. 我们要求模型将试验管垂直地降低到架上(图3)。 在训练中都看不到目标和目标。 模型本身构造了策略:它抓住了倒在侧面的管子,把钳子转动,使管子垂直,并降低为一孔. 这具有挑战性,因为在放置时,孔被从每个相机中隐藏. 一个VLA通常需要针对每个这些步骤的具体任务演示;ZAP只接收一个单一的文本指令,在没有演示或参数更新的情况下,推断所需的运动.

blocks.en: Steered by the instruction. The model brings the language understanding of its pretrained LLM into its actions. VLAs often respond poorly to changes in their prompts [ 35 ] . ZAP is able to follow precise instructions; on the same starting scene, we replace the instruction with a request to place the tube in a hole at the top left of the rack. With the default prompt, the model picks a hole on its own; with the new one, the tube ends up in the top-left corner (Figure 4 ).
blocks.zh: 以训导为导. 该模型将语言理解带入其行动,使其了解其经过预先训练的LLM. VLA经常对其提示中的变化反应不佳 [35]. ZAP能够遵循精确的指示;在同一起动场景中,我们用请求将管子放入架子左上方的洞来代替指示. 以默认的快取来,模型自行取出一孔;用新取出一孔来,管子最后会倒入左上角(图4.

blocks.zh: 图5:中空双人交接. 来自交接插曲的帧,在文字中逐个描述. 培训中没有接近交接的双人互动。

blocks.en: A new strategy on request: bimanual handoff. We then ask for a completely different way to reach the same goal: hand the tube from one arm to the other in mid-air, then place it in the rack (Figure 5 ). The prompt describes the handoff in writing, but training contains no bimanual interaction even close to a handoff. The model orients the tube-cap up and brings it, held by one arm, to the middle of the table; brings the other arm over the tube and descends from above, just far enough to grasp the cap but not so low that it hits the first arm; closes the receiving gripper, then opens the giving one; moves the giving arm out of the way; and lowers the tube into a hole. Getting this right means timing the two grippers against each other: if the giving arm lets go too early the tube falls, and if the receiving arm comes in too low the grippers collide.
blocks.zh: 应请求制定的新战略:双人交接。 然后,我们要求用完全不同的方法来达到同一个目标:在中空把管子从一臂接到另一臂上,再放入架子(图5. 该提示以书面方式描述交接,但训练中甚至没有接近交接的双人互动. 模型将管盖指向上并带出,由一臂所持;将另一臂取出于管上并自上而下,仅能取出管盖而下至下至下至下至下至下至下至下至下至下至下至下入出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出 得到这个正确意味着两个抓手相互对接的时间:如果给力的手臂让出太早的管子倒下,如果接收的手臂进得太低,抓手会相撞.

blocks.en: Figure 6: Reasoning about what the goal means. Top: tic-tac-toe, prompted to draw an X in the center of the board. Bottom: chess, prompted with black to move, mate in one.
blocks.zh: 图6:目标含义的理由。 上:ttic-tac-toe,被催生出在棋盘中心画出一个X. 下:入围棋,被黑色所诱使出动,一分一分.

blocks.en: Complex reasoning: tic-tac-toe and chess. The last two tasks require the model to reason about what a goal means before it can act (Figure 6 ). For tic-tac-toe, we prompt the model to draw an X in the center of a tic tac toe game drawn on a whiteboard. It picks up the marker, recognizes what a tic-tac-toe board is and where its center square lies, and draws the X: it keeps enough contact to leave a line through each stroke, without pressing so hard that it breaks or dislodges the marker. The instruction determines both a place on the board and the motion needed to draw there.
blocks.zh: 复杂的推理:ttic-tac-toe和围棋. 后两项任务要求模型在行动前对目标的含义进行推理(图6). 对于ttic-tac-toe,我们促使模型在从白板上绘制的ttic-tac toe游戏的中心画出一个X. 它能取出标记,识别出什么是ttic-tac-toe board及其中心平面所在,并绘制出X:它保持了足够的接触,通过每次中风留下一行,而不会按得那么硬,以至于它会断裂或拆散标记. 指令既决定了棋盘上的位置,也决定了画板所需的运动.

blocks.en: For chess, we prompt the model that it is black to move, with mate in one. It observes the board, reasons about the rules of chess to find the single mating move, and then picks up the correct piece and sets it on the target square to complete the checkmate. Through reasoning, the model has determined which piece to grasp and where to put it.
blocks.zh: 对于国际象棋,我们促使模型 它黑色移动, 配一个。 它观察棋盘,棋子规则上的理由,以找到单相交接动作,再取出正确的棋子并放入目标平方上来完成棋手. 通过推理,模型确定了要抓住的棋子和放在哪里.

blocks.en: 6 Conclusion
blocks.zh: 6 结论

blocks.en: A robot policy does not need to learn reasoning and motion together from scarce robot data. A 27B VLM brings world understanding and reasoning from pretraining, and SFT followed by RL on 40 simple simulated tasks adds the skill of moving a bimanual robot. A checkpoint trained exclusively in simulation reaches 96.7% success on real hardware tasks, matching GPT-6 Astra in our harness while running 3 × \times faster and 17 × \times cheaper, and transfers to a single-arm Franka. Its skills also compose on new real tasks, objects, language and goals: seating a test tube, choosing a different hole when asked, performing a mid-air handoff, drawing an X on a tic-tac-toe board, and playing a checkmate. Because the motion skill comes entirely from simulation, extending it calls for more simulated tasks rather than more robot demonstrations.
blocks.zh: 机器人政策不需要从稀缺的机器人数据中共同学习推理和运动. A 27B VLM从预训中带来世界的理解和推理,而SFT后再用RL来完成40个简单的模拟任务,增加了移动双人机器人的技能. 一个完全接受模拟训练的检查站在真正的硬件任务上达到了96.7%的成功率,它匹配了GPT-6 Astra在我们的操纵中,同时运行速度快了3xxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxx 其技能还以新的真实任务,对象,语言和入球来作曲:坐到试管上,在被问到时选择了不同的洞口,进行中空接取,在ttic-tac-toe板上画出X,并出演了棋手. 因为运动技巧完全来自于模拟,扩展它需要更多的模拟任务而不是更多的机器人演示.

Tools. ZAP has five tools. move_to moves one or both arms to a complete end-effector pose; naming both arms in one call produces a single synchronized motion. set_gripper sets each jaw opening, from 0 (closed) to 1 (fully open). change_query sets the text descriptions of the objects that perception segments. update_todo writes a short plan that is repeated in every later observation, so it survives when old turns are

blocks.en: Poses. Each move_to gives an absolute position of the tool center point, in meters, and a full orientation, in a world frame shared by both arms. Perception reports object positions in the same frame and units, so a measured centroid can be used directly as a target. The harness has no relative moves, grasp macros or approach primitives. In earlier versions, such macros raised success on the objects they were designed around but got in the way on everything else. Without them, the model plans the approach, grasp, lift, transport and release itself, and the motions it learned on pick and place carry over to rotating a tube, a mid-air handoff and drawing with a marker (§ 5 ).
blocks.zh: 发作。 每个动作_给工具中心点一个绝对位置,以公尺为单位,并在由两臂共用的世界框中完全取向. 感知报告对象是同一帧和单位中的位置,因此可直接将被测量到的百分数作为目标. 绳子没有相对的动作,抓住宏观或者接近原始人. 在早期的版本中,这种宏在它们周围设计的物体上提高了成功率,但在其他所有物体上却受到阻碍. 没有它们,模型就规划了方法、抓住、抬起、运输和释放,它在取取和放置时学到的动作将转而旋转一管、中空接取并用标记绘制(第5节)。

blocks.en: Orientation. Orientation is given by three angles, each measured counterclockwise from world + x +x (Figure 7 ). Slot yaw ψ \psi is the heading of the jaw slot, the axis a held object lies along. Tilt τ \tau is the angle of the tool axis from straight down: 0 ∘ 0^{\circ} is top-down and 90 ∘ 90^{\circ} is horizontal. Tilt direction ϕ \phi is the compass direction the fingertips point toward. We use these instead of Euler angles or quaternions for two reasons. Neither of those states directly where the gripper points or how its jaws are aligned, the two quantities that decide a grasp. And a horizontal tool, as in a side grasp, lies at an Euler singularity, where a few degrees of physical error can show up as a change of about 100 ∘ 100^{\circ} in the reported angles. Our angles are ambiguous only when the tool points straight down or straight up, where tilt direction has no physical meaning.
blocks.zh: 定向 方向由三个角度给出,每个角度都是从世界+x+x来逆时针(图7. Slot yaw \ psi 是下巴插槽的取向, 轴被持有的物体位于旁边。 Tilt \ tau是工具轴从正下方向下角: 0 \\\\\ circ}是自上而下, 90 \\\\ 90\ circ} 是水平的 。 倾斜的方向是指尖指向的指南针方向。 我们使用这些 而不是欧拉角度或四分法 有两个原因。 没有一个能直接说明 钳子的指向 或它的下巴是如何对齐的 这两个数量决定了抓取。 而一个水平工具,如侧取法,则位于一个欧拉单数上,其中几度的物理误差可以显示为报告角度上大约100-∘100-^{\Circ}的变化. 只有当工具直接向下或向上直指,倾斜方向没有物理意义时,我们的角度才模糊不清.

blocks.en: Observations and perception. Each turn adds one observation to the conversation: one downscaled RGB image from each of the three cameras (for bimanual YAM, overhead and one per wrist), the perception results, the measured tool pose and jaw opening of each arm, and the remaining step budget. Perception uses SAM 3.1 [ 27 , 28 ] , which runs continuously in the background on every camera stream rather than as a tool the model calls and waits on. It segments the objects named by the current queries, draws their masks and numbered boxes on the images, and uses depth to compute each object’s 3D centroid, height and principal axes in world coordinates. The model controls perception only through change_query , which it can call at any time, for example to find a missed object or to segment part of one, such as the cap of a tube. Detections are not fused across cameras; the model decides which ones refer to the same object. In simulation, perception runs on the rendered images and depth, as it does on the real cameras, and never reads any privileged information such as object poses that would be unavailable on hardware.
blocks.zh: 观察与观想. 每个转弯会给对话增加一面观察:从三个相机(双相相机为YAM,上相机为一相机为一相机为一相机为一相机为一相机为一相机为一相机为一相机为一相机为一相机为一相机为一相机为一相机为一相机为一相机为一相机为一相机为一相机为一相机为一相机为一相机为一相机为一相机为一相机为一相机为一相机为一相机为一相机为一相机为一相机为一相机为一相机为一相机为一相机为一相机为一相机为一相机为一相机为一相机为一相机为一相机为一相机为一相机为一相机为一相机为一相机为一相机为一相机为一相机为一相机为一相机为一相机为一相机为一相机为一相机为一相机为一相机为 Perception使用SAM 3.1 [27,28],它在每个相机流的背景中连续运行,而不是作为模型调用并等待的工具. 它会分出由当前查询所命名的物体,在图像上画出它们的口罩和编号的盒子,并用深度来计算每个物体在世界坐标上的3D中心机器人,高度和主轴. 模型只能通过更改_query来控制感知,它可以随时调用,例如寻找被忽略的物体或分出一个部分,如管子的盖. 探测器不通过相机接通;模型决定了哪个指同一种物体. 在模拟中,感知在所渲染的图像和深度上运行,就像它在真实相机上一样,从不读取任何在硬件上无法获取的特权信息,如物体外形等.

blocks.en: Validation. Before a move_to call reaches the controller, the harness checks it against limits declared for the robot, such as tilt range and workspace bounds. A call that fails a check is refused rather than clipped to a nearby feasible value, and the model receives the reason as an error message so it can try something else.
blocks.zh: 鉴定. 在移动_呼叫到达控制器之前,被控制器对照为机器人宣布的极限,例如倾斜范围与工作空间界限来检查. 无法检查的呼叫被拒绝,而不是被剪切到相邻的可行值上,而模型作为错误消息收到原因,从而可以尝试其他的东西.

blocks.en: Controller and outcome reports. The controller turns a valid pose into a straight-line Cartesian path, solves inverse kinematics densely along it, and refuses the motion if the resulting joint path cannot be validated. When the arm comes to rest, the controller reports one of five outcomes per arm: reached (execution completed and the arm came to rest within tolerance), short (the arm came to rest outside tolerance), incomplete (execution began but did not finish, for example because of a stall), not attempted (nothing moved, for example because no valid path exists) or unknown (the outcome could not be determined). Any outcome other than reached also reports its cause, whether it arose in planning or execution, and the measured position and orientation errors.
blocks.zh: 主计长和成果报告。 控制器将有效姿势转化为直线笛卡尔路径,解决了沿途的反向动能密集,如果产生的联合路径无法验证,则拒绝运动. 当手臂休息时,控制者报告每个手臂的五个结果之一:达到(执行完成而手臂在容忍范围内休息),短(手臂在容忍之外休息),不完全(执行开始而未能完成,例如因为一个摊位),没有尝试(没有移动,例如因为没有有效的路径)或未知(结果无法确定). 除达成成果外,任何其他成果也都报告了其原因,无论是在规划还是执行过程中出现的结果,以及衡量的立场和方向错误。

blocks.en: One harness for simulation and hardware. The harness is the same in simulation and on the real robot. Everything specific to a robot, such as joint limits, cameras and workspace bounds, comes from a declarative embodiment description. Moving from the simulator to the real rig, or to the Franka, means swapping that description and the low-level backend, and nothing else. This is why a policy trained only in simulation runs on the real robot without changes.
blocks.zh: 一台模拟和硬件机 在模拟和真正的机器人上,绳子是一样的。 机器人所特有的一切,如联想极限,相机和工作空间界限,都出自一种宣示式的化身描述. 从模拟器到真实的钻机,或者说到弗兰卡,意味着交换这个描述和低等后端,没有别的了. 正因为如此,一项只接受模拟训练的政策,在真正的机器人上运行时没有变化.

blocks.zh: 附录B 一个真正的机器人剧集 转身

blocks.en: To make the agent loop of § 3.1 concrete, we step through one complete episode of ZAP on the real bimanual rig. The task is “pick up both blocks”. The episode succeeds in 9 turns and 74.6 s of wall-clock time, with 4 robot actions, 118,985 input tokens and 1,920 output tokens. Each image is the observation the agent received at the start of that turn (left wrist, overhead, right wrist); from turn 2 on it includes the SAM 3.1 masks and numbered boxes for the current perception queries, computed in the background. The overhead camera faces the arms from across the table, so its image-left is the robot’s right. Below each image we give an excerpt of the model’s reasoning, the single tool call it emitted, and the result the harness returned, which reaches the agent as the tool message at the start of the next turn. Reasoning is abridged with […]; tool calls are verbatim.
blocks.zh: 为了让第3.1节混凝土的代理循环,我们踏入了真正的双人钻机上的一整集ZAP. 任务是“挑出两个块”。 剧集以9个转弯和74.6 s的墙钟时间相继成功,有4个机器人动作,118,985个输入符和1,920个出品符. 每个图像都是在转弯之初(左手腕、上部和右手腕)收到的观察;从转弯2起,它包括SAM 3.1口罩和用于当前感知查询的编号框,按背景计算。 上面的相机面对着桌子对面的手臂,所以它的图像左侧是机器人的右侧. 在每一个图像下,我们给出一个模型推理的节选, 单一工具称它为释放, 并返回了结果, 它在下一个回合开始时作为工具信息到达了代理。 理由是[.];工具电话是逐字记录。

blocks.en: GRPO. We train with GRPO [ 36 ] in the style of Dr. GRPO [ 37 ] , with no standard-deviation or per-sequence length normalization, using LoRA. 2 groups per task and 8 rollouts per group: 640 episodes per batch over 40 tasks. LoRA, rank 64. Up to 50 turns per episode; maximum sequence length 127k tokens. STAPO [ 38 ] enabled; DPPO [ 39 ] mask with threshold 0.2; maximum staleness 5. Asynchronous training in the style of prime-rl [ 40 ] .

blocks.en: Compositional reasoning in robotics. Classical robotics composes behavior explicitly. Task-and-motion planners search over symbolic operators that ground into geometric motion [ 11 , 41 , 12 ] . Learned variants acquire the operators, their abstractions or their programs from data [ 42 , 43 , 44 , 45 ] , or chain learned skills with generative models [ 46 ] , or compose diffusion policies across tasks and domains [ 47 ] . Coding agents can also synthesize generalized TAMP programs [ 48 ] . Language models later took over the high-level planner: they plan zero-shot in language or as programs [ 49 , 50 ] , sequence a library of learned skills [ 13 , 14 , 15 ] , hand subgoals to RL-trained or local low-level policies [ 16 , 17 ] , or supply open-world constraints to a TAMP solver [ 51 , 52 ] . ZAP keeps the split between reasoning and motion but drops the fixed skill library. The interface is a set of tools in physical units, and motion is a skill the model learns itself, so a grasp learned on pick and place can be reused as a tube rotation or a marker stroke.
blocks.zh: 机器人学中的组成推理. 古典机器人的作曲明确了行为. 任务和动作规划者对显示几何运动的象征性操作者进行搜索[11,41,12]. 学习的变体从数据[42、43、44、45]获得操作员、其抽象体或其程序,或将学习的技能与遗传模型相挂钩[46],或制定跨任务和领域的传播政策[47]。 编码剂也可以合成通用的TAMP程序[48]. 语言模型后来接管了高级计划员:他们计划用语言或作为程序[49,50]的零镜头,排序一个学习技能的库[13,14,15],将子目标交给经过RL训练或当地低级别政策[16,17],或向TAMP解析器提供开放世界的限制[51,52]. ZAP保持推理和运动的分出,但放弃了固定技能库. 界面是物理单元中的一组工具,而运动是模型自我学习的一种技能,因此在取地和取地上所学到的取地可以被再用作管旋转或打出标记中风.

blocks.en: End-to-end policies and their compositional limits. Embodied multimodal language models [ 53 ] and vision-language-action models (VLAs) fold reasoning and motion into one network trained on robot actions, increasingly pooled across embodiments [ 54 , 55 , 1 , 2 , 3 , 56 , 57 , 58 , 4 ] . World-action models (WAMs) additionally predict future observations alongside actions, using video as a dense representation of how the world evolves [ 18 , 59 , 60 ] . Zero-WAM uses in-context human videos to guide unseen tasks [ 61 ] , while ObjDream uses object-level representations and future object-state prediction to improve generalization to new layouts and backgrounds [ 62 ] . Some recover a hierarchy inside the model through embodied chain-of-thought or a high-level policy [ 63 , 64 , 65 , 66 ] . Several studies show that these policies keep the intent of an instruction but fail to execute it on new tasks, held-out perturbations or new skill combinations [ 19 , 20 , 21 , 67 ] . Recent diagnoses also find that current VLAs struggle with instructions specifying how to carry out a task [ 22 ] . One reason is that compositional coverage in action data is expensive to collect [ 68 ] . Benchmarks now measure compositional generalization directly, from compositional RL suites [ 69 ] to arm-wise composition in dual-arm VLAs [ 70 ] , alongside standard manipulation benchmarks [ 71 ] and real-to-sim evaluation [ 72 ] . ZAP learns no reasoning from action data; it learns only motion, and only in simulation.
blocks.zh: 端到端政策及其构成限制. 健全的多模式语言模型[53]和视觉语言行动模型(VLAs)将推理和运动折叠成一个受过机器人行动训练的网络,并越来越多地汇集到各种表现形式[54、55、1、2、3、56、57、58、4]。 世界行动模式(WAMS)还预测了今后的观测与行动,将视频作为世界演变的密集表现[18、59、60]。 Zero-WAM使用内置的人类视频来引导隐形任务[61],而ObjDream则使用对象级别表示和未来的对象状态预测来改进对新布局和背景的概括化[62]. 有些国家通过体现的思想链或高级别政策恢复模式内的等级[63、64、65、66]。 一些研究表明,这些政策保留着一项指示的意图,但未能执行新的任务、被搁置的干扰或新的技能组合[19、20、21、67]。 近期的诊断还发现,目前VLA与说明如何执行某项任务的指令相冲突[22]. 其中一个原因是,行动数据的组成涵盖范围收集费用昂贵[68]。 基准现在直接衡量组成概况,从组成式RL套件[69]到双臂VLA的臂-臂-臂-臂-臂-臂-臂-臂-臂-臂-臂-臂-臂-臂-臂-臂-臂-臂-臂-臂-臂-臂-臂-臂-臂-臂-臂-臂-臂-臂-臂-臂-臂-臂-臂-臂-臂-臂-臂-臂-臂-臂-臂-臂-臂-臂-臂-臂-臂-臂-臂-臂-臂-臂-臂-臂-臂-臂-臂-臂-臂-臂-臂-臂-臂-臂-臂-臂-臂-臂-臂-臂-臂-臂-臂-臂-臂-臂-臂-臂-臂-臂-臂-臂-臂-臂-臂-臂-翼------------翼----------------------------------------- ZAP没有从动作数据中学习推理;它只学习运动,只在模拟中学习.

blocks.en: Foundation models as robot agents. Code as Policies and its successors compose perception and control APIs into programs or value maps [ 5 , 23 , 73 ] , in the style of tool-using agents [ 74 ] . RAX compiles a coding agent’s online exploration into robot programs that run without the agent [ 75 ] ; MoCaP uses passive human videos to guide code-as-policy for mobile manipulation [ 76 ] . Multimodal language-model agents remain weak at low-level manipulation when used off the shelf [ 77 ] . Recent work nonetheless uses frontier agents directly as closed-loop policies: on real YAM arms [ 7 , 8 , 32 ] , including head-to-head comparisons with VLAs on bimanual tasks [ 78 ] and in simulation [ 79 ] , through general agent frameworks [ 80 , 81 ] , through a visual interface [ 82 ] , through in-context learning [ 83 ] , through primitive motion commands [ 84 ] , or with perception tools and test-time simulation [ 9 , 85 , 86 ] . SEAR compares code-as-policy, agent-as-policy and VLA auto-research, with controls that separate retained experience from repeated attempts and larger budgets [ 87 ] .
blocks.zh: 基础模型作为机器人代理. 代码作为"政策"及其后继者将感知和控制API编成程序或值图[5,23,73],以工具使用剂的风格[74]. RAX将编码代理的在线探索编译为没有代理运行的机器人程序[75];MOCaP使用被动的人类视频来指导代码-作为政策进行移动操纵[76]. 在从货架卸下使用时,在低级操纵下,多式语言模型代理仍然很薄弱[77]. 然而,最近的工作直接将边境代理人作为封闭式启动政策:在真正的YAM武器[7、8、32]上,包括在双人任务上与VLA进行头对头比较[78];在模拟[79]中,通过一般代理框架[80、81],通过视觉界面[82],通过内文学习[83],通过原始运动指令[84],或利用感知工具和测试时间模拟[9、85、86]。 SEAR将 " 即时守则 " 、 " 即时代理政策 " 和 " VLA " 自动研究与将经验与反复尝试和更大的预算分开的控制进行比较[87]。

blocks.en: Other work improves the harness, with evolving code, skill libraries or playbooks [ 88 , 89 , 90 , 91 , 92 , 93 ] . URAI lets frontier agents write, call and evolve reusable robot tools [ 94 ] , while ChunkAct chains primitives into action chunks to reduce model calls [ 95 ] . Some harnesses surround a VLA: Cracking Mobile Manipulation adds planning, navigation and local-motion interventions around a fixed policy [ 96 ] , and CarryOn adds planning and execution loops with reusable recovery skills [ 97 ] . AdaRSI first improves the harness, then fine-tunes the executor on sub-steps that remain unreliable [ 98 ] .
blocks.zh: 其他工作改进了管理方式,不断演变的代码、技能图书馆或游戏本[88、89、90、91、92、93]。 URAI让边疆特工写作,调用并进化出可再使用的机器人工具[94],而ChunkAct 链条原始为动作块来减少模型调用[95]. 一些工具环绕着一个VLA: Cracking Mobile Manipulation增加了围绕固定政策的规划,导航和局部运动干预[96],而CryOn增加了具有可再用回收技能的规划和执行循环[97]. AdaRSI首先改进了管带,然后在仍然不可靠的子步骤上对执行者进行微调[98].

blocks.en: Concurrent work adapts frontier-agent skills from simulation to hardware without weight updates [ 99 , 100 , 101 ] . SimEX develops a robot toolbox in simulation, then adapts it and the simulator through a few physical trials [ 102 ] . ZAP trains the motion skill into an open 27B model that runs 3 × \times faster and 17 × \times cheaper than the frontier model it matches.
blocks.zh: 同时期工作将前沿代理技能从模拟改为硬件,不更新重量[99,100,101]. SimEX在模拟中开发出一个机器人工具箱,然后通过一些物理试验来调整它和模拟器[102]. ZAP将运动技能训练成开放的27B型,运行速度快于3××时,17××时比相匹配的边疆型更便宜.

blocks.en: VLMs that directly predict actions. EASG projects a tool-center-point action frame into the wrist-camera image and lets a pretrained VLM generate continuous translations and rotations as text [ 103 ] . This grounds the action space for zero-shot manipulation, and the same interface supports fine-tuning on robot trajectories. ZAP also uses the model’s native text generation to command motion, learning full absolute end-effector poses through SFT and RL entirely in simulation.
blocks.zh: 直接预测动作的VLM. EASG在手腕相机图像中投放一个工具-中心点的动作框架,并让一个预先训练的VLM产生连续的翻译和旋转作为文本[103]. 这为零发操纵的动作空间提供了理由,同一种界面支持对机器人轨迹进行微调. ZAP还使用模型的原生文本生成来命令运动,完全在模拟中通过SFT和RL来学习完全绝对的终端效应.

blocks.en: Small trained robot agents. The closest work trains compact agents. Guava distills frontier-model trajectories collected in simulation into a 4B agent using semantic grasp and align tools [ 24 ] . RACaP evolves reusable policy APIs, then distills frontier-model ReAct decisions into an 8B model for efficient deployment [ 25 ] . Show-Harness fine-tunes a 2B model on discrete action units, partly on RoboLab [ 104 ] . Robo-Harness K1 distills a 9B student, evaluated only in simulation [ 9 ] . CaP-RL trains a 7B code-writing model with GRPO in simulation and transfers it to cube lifting and stacking [ 6 ] .
blocks.zh: 训练有素的机器人特工 最接近的工作 火车紧凑的代理。 Guava将模拟中收集到的前沿-模型轨迹分解为使用语义抓取并配合工具的4B剂 [24]. RACaP将可重复使用的政策API演化,再将前沿-模型再法案决定提炼成高效部署的8B模型[25]. Show-Harness在离散动作单元上微调了2B模型,部分在RoboLab [104]上. Robo-Harness K1蒸馏出一个9B学生,只在模拟[9]中评价. CaP-RL在模拟中与GRPO一起进行7B代码写入模型的训练并转让给立方体起重和堆放[6].

blocks.en: Other work fine-tunes VLM agents for manipulation question answering [ 105 ] or calls a small agent-ready action model through tools [ 106 ] . ZAP trains mainly with RL on its own multi-turn simulation rollouts to command full robot poses. Beyond Guava’s tested recombinations of familiar skills, ZAP shows new real-world strategies, including a mid-air handoff and marker drawing, and transfers the same checkpoint from bimanual YAM to simulated Franka without retraining.
blocks.zh: 其他工作对VLM代理进行微调,用于操纵问题回答[105],或通过工具调用小型代理准备行动模型[106]. ZAP列车主要使用RL进行自有多回合模拟推出来指挥全机器人姿势. 除了经过测试的瓜娃对熟悉技能的再组合之外,ZAP还展示了新的现实世界策略,包括中空交接和标记图纸,并将同一个检查站从双人YAM转移至模拟Franka而不进行再培训.

blocks.en: RL for language-model agents and embodied reasoning. Online RL can ground language models as policies in text and simulated environments [ 107 , 108 , 109 ] . Multi-turn agent RL has since scaled with GRPO-style objectives [ 36 , 110 , 111 , 112 , 113 ] . In robotics, RL has sharpened embodied and physical reasoning in VLMs, for example pointing and keypoint prediction [ 114 , 115 , 116 ] , has fine-tuned VLAs in simulation [ 117 , 118 , 119 ] , and has trained agentic recovery decisions over VLA execution [ 120 ] , including at scale for sim-to-real transfer [ 121 ] . ZAP applies multi-turn GRPO to a VLM tool agent whose actions are real robot motions.
blocks.zh: 语言模型代理商的RL和体现的推理. 在线RL可以将语言模型作为文字政策和模拟环境[107,108,109]. 多回合代理RL后来随着GRPO风格的目标而缩放[36,110,111,112,113]. 在机器人学方面,RL在VLMs中强化了所体现和物理推理,例如指向和关键点预测[114,115,116],在模拟中微调了VLA[117,118,119],并就VLA执行[120]培训了代理恢复决定[120],包括规模的模拟到实际转移[121]. ZAP将多回合GRPO应用于一个VLM工具代理,其动作是真正的机器人动作.

blocks.en: Sim-to-real. Domain and dynamics randomization made simulation-only training viable for low-level control [ 122 , 123 , 124 ] . Large procedurally generated simulations now transfer manipulation policies zero-shot [ 125 ] , and object-centric abstractions narrow the gap further [ 126 ] . We use Isaac Sim and RoboLab [ 29 , 127 , 30 ] . Our tool interface acts as the abstraction: the observations and actions the model sees are the same in simulation and on hardware [ 128 ] . As a result, only dynamics and perception, not the interface, differ between the two.
blocks.zh: 斯为正相. 域和动态随机化使得模拟-唯一训练对低水平控制是可行的[122,123,124]. 大型程序生成的模拟现在转移操纵政策零发[125],以对象为中心的抽象进一步缩小了差距[126]. 我们使用艾萨克・西姆和RoboLab[29,127,30]。 我们的工具界面起到抽象的作用:模型看到的观察和行动在模拟和硬件[128]上是相同的. 因此,只有动态和感知,而不是界面,两者不同.
